title: Modded Life

# 🗨️ About the Modpack

This modpack enhances Minecraft by improving performance, adding new gameplay features, and expanding building, decorating, and exploration options. It includes a curated set of quality-of-life tools, optimization mods, and decorative content designed to make the game smoother and more enjoyable.

## ✅ What It Adds
- **Performance & Optimization:** Boost FPS, reduce lag, optimize memory, and improve chunk/entity handling with mods like [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), [Phosphor](https://modrinth.com/mod/phosphor), and [C2ME](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me).
- **Building & Decoration:** Expand your creative options with furniture, bridges, doors, windows, roofs, stairs, lights, and statues. Example mods: [Adorn](https://modrinth.com/mod/adorn), [Macaw's Bridges](https://modrinth.com/mod/macaws-bridges), [Armor Statues](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor-statues).
- **Equipment & Combat:** New armor tiers, customizable elytra, tridents, weapons, and advanced enchantment management. Example mods: [Advanced Netherite](https://modrinth.com/mod/advanced-netherite), [Armored Elytra](https://modrinth.com/mod/armored-elytra), [Better Tridents](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-tridents).
- **Food & Survival:** Better hunger tracking, cooking, farming, and trading with villagers. Example mods: [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin), [Farmer's Delight Refabricated](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated), [Universal Bone Meal](https://modrinth.com/mod/universal-bone-meal).
- **Exploration & Navigation:** Find biomes, structures, and navigate efficiently with maps, compasses, waystones, and zoom mods. Example mods: [Explorer's Compass](https://modrinth.com/mod/explorers-compass), [Nature's Compass](https://modrinth.com/mod/natures-compass), [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap).
- **Utilities & Quality of Life:** Inventory management, item tracking, UI customization, freecam, shulker box tooltips, and more. Example mods: [Carry On](https://modrinth.com/mod/carry-on), [Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks), [Trash Cans](https://modrinth.com/mod/trash-cans).
- **Audio & Visual Enhancements:** 3D player skins, capes, textures, lighting improvements, and background music. Example mods: [3D Skin Layers](https://modrinth.com/mod/3d-skin-layers), [ETF Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures), [Gamma Utils](https://modrinth.com/mod/gamma-utils).


## 🎯 Why Download
This modpack provides both casual and advanced players a richer, smoother, and more immersive Minecraft experience. Whether you want better performance, easier navigation, or more creative options, it bundles essential mods in one package.

## 🛠️ Roadmap
1. **Upcoming Content Updates** – Add more decorative and furniture mods for enhanced building.
2. **Performance Enhancements** – Integrate new optimization mods as they are released and update existing ones.
3. **Exploration Expansion** – Add additional adventure and structure mods for more world content.
4. **User Feedback Integration** – Regular updates based on community suggestions and bug reports.
5. **Compatibility Checks** – Ensure seamless experience with future Minecraft versions and Fabric updates.
